info.title: Granite Manager API
info.description: JSON API behind Granite Manager, a CRM for countertop and stone fabrication companies. Every request acts as the signed-in user and only sees data of that user's company.

get.description:
Returns the user behind the session, including their permission flags and
the company every other request acts in.

The user's details in their home company, and what the page shows: the
texting providers, the signature, and the guided tours rating.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or of the shop

put.description:
Saves the user's details in their home company. A new password ends the
user's other sessions. The texting line is checked with its provider (the
`RingCentral` extension is looked up from the number), and a number moved
from `CloudTalk` to `RingCentral` brings its texting history along. A newly
filled email name or signature completes its setup task, with its points.

400.description: A field is invalid

403.description: Caller is not an employee or of the shop

409.description: The email belongs to another account

get.description:
Returns every non-deleted customer of the caller's company, optionally
filtered by sales rep. Invalid leads are hidden unless `show_invalid=1`.
With `view=companies` it returns only customers that have a company name,
each with revenue and project totals. Rows carry the primary email only;
use `POST /v1/customers/emails/batch` for all addresses.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
`customers` (default) lists every customer. `companies` lists only
customers with a company name and adds revenue and project totals.
Any other value is treated as `customers`.

parameters.name: sales_rep
parameters.description:
Only customers assigned to this sales rep (a user id, see
`GET /v1/users/sales-reps`). Omit or leave empty for all reps.

parameters.name: show_invalid
parameters.description:
`1` also returns leads marked invalid. Ignored when `view=companies`,
which never filters invalid leads out.

400.description: `sales_rep` is not an integer

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

refused). Without a sales rep, a sales rep creating a customer (other
than a walk-in) becomes its rep. An assigned customer gets an open deal
and an audit line; the telephony address books are updated.

get.summary: List the company's stones with slab availability
get.description:
Returns the stones of the caller's company that are on display (admins may
add hidden ones with `include_hidden=true`), sorted by name, each with counts of its slabs in the yard (`slabs`). Sold out stones
(no available slab and not regular stock) are hidden unless
`include_sold_out=true`; hidden and deleted stones are never returned.
Filters combine with AND; list filters take the parameter repeated and
match any value. Color ids come from the colors list, supplier ids from
the suppliers list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only stones of these types, e.g. `granite`, `quartz`, `marble`.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only stones bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: color_id
parameters.description: Only stones tagged with at least one of these colors (color ids).

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Only stones of these price levels (1 = cheapest ... 7).

parameters.name: finishing
parameters.description: Only stones with these surface finishes: `polished`, `leathered`, `honed`.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out stones: no available slab and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description:
`true` also returns stones hidden from the catalogs (`is_display`
false). Admins only (403 otherwise). Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or shop staff, or asks for hidden stones without being an admin

post.description:
Creates a stone of the caller's company with its image (an upload to the
`stones` folder, thumbnail made here) and colors. Add its slabs with
`POST /v1/stones/{id}/slabs`.

400.description: Missing name or image, unknown type, supplier or color, bad finishing, level, size or date

403.description: Caller is not an admin

get.summary: Search the company's stones by name
get.description:

first (name starts with it, then contains it as a word), each with the
same fields and slab counts as `GET /v1/stones`. By default only
displayed stones that are regular stock or have an available whole slab;
see `include_sold_out` and `include_hidden`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Part of the stone name, case-insensitive. Empty returns no stones.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out stones. By default a stone is listed
when it is regular stock or has an available whole slab.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description:
`true` also returns stones hidden from the catalog (`is_display`
false). Default `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most stones to return, 1 to 50. Default 25.

400.description: A parameter has the wrong type

403.description: Caller is not an employee, admin or of the shop

get.summary: List the company's sink models with free units
get.description:
Returns the non-deleted sink models of the caller's company, sorted by
name, each with the number of units free to sell (`available`). Models
not on display are included (`is_display`). Sold out models (no free unit
and not regular stock) are hidden unless `include_sold_out=true`. Filters
combine with AND; `type` takes the parameter repeated and matches any value.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only sink models of these types: `stainless 18 gauge`, `stainless 16 gauge`,
`composite`, `ceramic`, `farm house`. Repeat the parameter for several.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only sink models bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out models: no free unit and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description:
`true` returns only models with at least one free unit, even regular
stock ones without units (what can be installed on a sale right now).
Overrides `include_sold_out`. Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Creates a sink model of the caller's company with its image (an upload
to the `sinks` folder; the thumbnail is made here) and, with `units`,
that many units in stock.

400.description: Missing name or image, unknown type or supplier, negative price, size or units

403.description: Caller is not an admin

400.description: Invalid field, or `units` below the installed units

bundle.description:
Bundle label written on the slab, e.g. "B-12-1" or "Slab 2". Remnants
keep the label of the slab they were cut from.

url.description: Photo of this slab; null when it has none (show the stone image).

length.description: Length in inches as entered, e.g. "126.5".

width.description: Width in inches as entered, e.g. "63".

parent_id.description: The slab this remnant was cut from; null for a whole slab.

child_count.description:
Remnants cut from this slab that are not deleted (sold, free or cut).
A slab with remnants can only be sold partially.

oneOf.description:
Set when the slab belongs to a stone this stone draws from (linked
stones): that stone's id and name. Null for the stone's own slabs.

sale_id.description:
Id of the sale the slab is part of; null while it is available. Set
even when the sale row itself is missing (then `sale` is null).

oneOf.description: The sale the slab is part of; null while it is available.

The sale of the slab this remnant was cut from; null for whole slabs
and for remnants of unsold slabs.

StoneType.description: A stone type (material) of the company, e.g. "granite".

name.description: Type name as entered; stones store it in their `type`.

StoneTypeInUse.description: 409 body of `DELETE /v1/stone-types/{id}`: the type is still used.

error.description: "This type is used by undeleted stones and cannot be deleted."

stones.description: Live stones of that type, by name; delete or retype them first.

name.description: 1 to 255 characters; unique per company, ignoring case.

StoneUsingType.description: A stone (or sink model) that uses a type.

SuggestionRow.description: The newest matching message of a conversation.

body.description: Plain text body (the client makes the snippet).

text.description: e.g. `11378 Gammel Pl, Fishers, IN, USA`.

Supplier.description: A supplier the company buys from.

SupplierEntry.description: A supplier with its contact details and files.

SupplierFile.description: A file (price list, catalog) of a supplier.

SupplierOffer.description: A price found in a supplier's price list.

supplier.description: Supplier, as the list names it.

name.description: Color or product name as the list writes it.

unit.description:
`sqft` or `slab`, decided by the amount: only a price too big for a
square foot that comes to a sensible one over the slab is a slab price.

slab.description: Slab size in inches, longer side first; null when the list gives none.

file.description: Price file it was read from.

url.description: A newly uploaded picture replacing the old one; leave out to keep it.

sales_rep_comments.description: What the customer said about the rep.

technician_comments.description: What the customer said about the technician.

installation_comments.description: What the customer said about the installation.

company_name.description: Company name; empty when the company does not exist.

sales_reps.description: The company's sales reps, by name.

sales_rep_id.description: The sales rep rated; one of the company's sales reps.

installer_id.description: The installer rated; one of the company's installers.

checklist_id.description:
The checklist of the survey link (`c`), with its signed token (`t`):
recording the completion stops the reminders. The answers are saved
without them, so the survey stays anonymous.

SurveyPerson.description: A person the customer can rate.

sent_by_day.description: Invitations sent per day, oldest first, one entry per day of the range.

waiting_for_send_window.description: Outside the send window: nothing was looked at.

SwitchableCompany.description: A company the super admin may act in.

referral_source.description: How they heard of the company.

TableDeal.description: A deal of the table's customers.

customer_id.description: The customer (else the phone's customer, if any).

version.description: Registry version the progress was recorded against.

step_key.description: The step the user is on.

points_awarded.description: Points it paid (completed tours only, never negative).

closed_at.description: When it was last closed (UTC, ISO 8601): a skip, unless completed since.

state_tax_pct.description: The company's state sales tax in percent; 0 when not set.

users.description: The company's sales reps, by name.

attempts.description: Their answers, by employee, newest try first.

enabled.description: The company's guided tours are on; off, `members` is empty.

TeamCapabilities.description: What the company can do, as the tour registry gates on it.

verified_domain.description: SES has verified the company's mail domain.

followup_tours.description: The follow-up tours are switched on (`FOLLOWUP_ONBOARDING_ENABLED`).

onboarding.description: The company's guided tours are on.

can_manage_users.description: Holds the Manager position (may manage users).

has_sms_line.description:
Has a texting line of their own (`CloudTalk` agent and number, or a
`RingCentral` extension and number).

TelegramLink.description: Body of `POST /v1/me/telegram/{bot}`: what the Telegram login widget returned.

crm_user_id.description: The CRM user the page linked for; must be the caller.

TelegramNumber.description: A Telegram id the widget sends as a number or a string.

TelegramStatus.description: Whether the signed-in user's Telegram is linked to each of the two bots.

leads_linked.description: Linked to the lead alerts bot.

notifications_linked.description: Linked to the CRM notifications bot.

leads_bot_id.description:
Telegram user id of the lead alerts bot, for the Telegram login
widget; null when the bot is not configured.

notifications_bot_id.description: Telegram user id of the notifications bot; null when not configured.

oneOf.description: `hot`, `medium`, `cold`, or null to clear.

TemplateAttachment.description: A file sent with every email made from a template.

url.description: URL of a file uploaded to the `email-templates` folder.

TemplateOrder.description: The caller's sorting of one picker.

completed.description: The caller once answered every one of its questions right in one try.

id.description: Customer id, when the address belongs to one.

name.description: Customer, header or coworker name; the address, or `Customer`.

sending_email.description: The address the caller's mail leaves from (theirs, or the shared one).

messages.description: Messages, oldest first (on a deal: the deal's and unassigned ones).

participants.description: Addresses of every message, in header order (no BCC).

customer_addresses.description: Every address of the customer, primary first (empty when unknown).

thread_ids.description: Conversation ids (only the caller's own threads are changed).

unread_count.description: Unread threads (ignoring the search when it matches nothing).

body.description: Plain text body.

html_body.description: HTML body, when the mail had one.

sender_user_id.description: Sending user; null for mail from outside.

signature.description: Email signature of the sending user.

read_at.description: When the recipient last opened it.

phone_digits.description: The other party's phone (the thread key).

customer_name.description: The customer's name, else a supplier's.

last_message_text.description: Text of the latest message (a photo or file label when it has none).

last_message_at.description: When the latest message was sent.

last_agent.description: Agent id on the latest message.

message_count.description: Messages in the conversation (matching the search, with one).

unread_count.description: Unread messages (1 when marked unread by hand).

text.description: The text (an email starts with its subject line).

TopSoldStone.description: A stone the signed-in user sold slabs of this month.

slabs_sold.description: Full slabs sold (remnants cut from them are not counted again).

square_feet.description: Square feet of those slabs, decimal string; "0.00" when no slab has a size.

TransactionDetail.description: A transaction as its dialog shows it.

sf.description: Square feet (the shop view: each room's, added up).

call_id.description: `CloudTalk`'s numeric call id, or the `RingCentral` call id.

recording_link.description:
The call's `recording_link`: a `RingCentral` media token or a
`CloudTalk` URL.

UnpricedModel.description: A model with free-looking usage and no price.

count.description: Unread inbox threads; 0 when the company has no inbound email.

latest_inbound_id.description: Newest unread message id, to notice new mail between polls.

monthly_sales_goal.description:
Goal for each month in USD, above 0 and below 10 billion; rounded to
cents.

UpdateSlab.description:
Body of `PATCH /v1/slabs/{id}`: the fields to change. Length and width
go together.

length.description: New length in inches; a positive number, decimals allowed.

width.description: New width in inches; a positive number, decimals allowed.

bundle.description: New bundle label (the slab number); not empty.

Upload.description: Where to upload, and the URL to give the record afterwards.

upload_url.description:
`PUT` the file body here (valid 15 minutes) with the `Content-Type`
given in the request.

url.description: Public URL of the file once uploaded; pass it to the record's route.

token.description:
`emails` only: proof the caller uploaded `url`; send it with the
attachment to `POST /v1/emails`.

UploadFolder.description: Where an upload goes; each record type takes files of its own folder.

folder.description: Folder of the record the file is for.

file_name.description: Original file name; only its extension is kept.

content_type.description:
MIME type of the file: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`,
`image/gif`, `image/heic` or `image/heif`; for `deals` and `documents` also PDF, Word,
Excel, CSV and plain text; for `sms-uploads` also AVIF, Word, Excel, PDF,
CSV, plain text and `application/octet-stream` (a file the browser could
not type); for `emails` and `email-templates` any type. Send the same value
as the `Content-Type` header of the `PUT`.

features.description: Features with calls in the range, by key.

unpriced_models.description: Models used for free without a price row.

calls.description: The page of calls, newest first.

id.description: Id of the row in its source.

summary.description: One line shown next to the action: email subject, activity name, ...

contact.description: Who it went to: an email address or phone number.

body.description: Longer text (capped), shown when the row is expanded.

tags.description: Labels: priority, stage, amount, "Received", ...

company_id.description: Superusers: move them to this company.

marketing_company_ids.description: External marketing: the companies they market for.

superadmin_company_ids.description: Superusers: the companies they are Super Admin of.

is_admin.description: Admin access (always on for Super Admins).

ringcentral_phone_number.description:
`RingCentral` number (10+ digits) or empty; the extension is looked up
from it.

superadmin_company_ids.description: Companies they are Super Admin of.

UserLimit.description: How many users a company has and may have.

current_count.description: Users counting toward the limit (check-in-only accounts do not).

UserNameRow.description: A user's id and display name.

company_id.description: The company listed; null for every company (superusers).

user_limits.description: Each pickable company's user count and limit.

WidgetAction.description: What a user did with a widget.

top_used.description: Uses per user, widget and target, most first.

current_widgets.description: Every user's dashboard widgets, by company, user and position.

WidgetEvent.description: One use of a dashboard widget, for product analytics.

target.description:
What in the widget was used, e.g. `quick-links` or `sales-goal`;
1 to 64 characters after trimming.

WidgetUse.description: How often users clicked or changed something on a widget.
